mapper.select: select from where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=#{version}
select from where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version for update
select from where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version desc limit 1
select id,version,revision,project_id,scope,payload from capability_record where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version desc
select id,version,revision,project_id,scope,payload from capability_record where bu_id=#{buId} and source_fingerprint=#{fingerprint}
select project_id,scope,payload from where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=#{version}
select project_id,scope,payload from where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=#{version} for update
select payload from where bu_id=#{buId} order by id,version

select r.payload,s.operation,s.synced_at is not null as synced,s.last_error is not null as has_error from `history-rfq-record` r left join history_rfq_index_sync s on s.bu_id=r.bu_id and s.reply_id=r.id and s.version=r.version where r.bu_id=#{buId} and not exists (select 1 from history_document d where d.bu_id=r.bu_id and d.id=r.payload->>'$.documentId' and d.payload->>'$.status'='已删除') order by r.id,r.version

select r.id,r.version,r.revision,r.project_id,r.scope,r.payload, (s.synced_at is not null and s.operation='upsert' and s.version=r.version) as synced, s.updated_at as sync_stamp from `history-rfq-record``standard-reply-record` r left join history_rfq_index_syncstandard_reply_index_sync s on s.bu_id=r.bu_id and s.reply_id=r.id where r.bu_id=#{buId} and (r.project_id is null or r.project_id=#{projectId}) and json_unquote(json_extract(r.payload,'$.status'))='已发布' and (#{fileFilter}='' or find_in_set(r.payload->>'$.documentId',#{fileFilter})>0) order by r.id,r.version
select payload from knowledge_group_catalog where bu_id=#{buId}
mapper.update: update set payload=#{payload},revision=#{revision} where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=#{version} and revision=#{previousRevision}
update set payload=#{payload} where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=#{version}
mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_group_catalog(bu_id,payload) values (#{buId},#{payload}) as desired on duplicate key update payload=desired.payload
